name: Armilar Venture Partners
facts: Deep tech: enterprise software, fintech, AI, health
Early backer of OutSystems and Feedzai
position: Armilar has been a deep-tech venture investor since 1999, backing teams that use technology to tackle large problems, and was an early investor in OutSystems and Feedzai. Its current portfolio is concentrated in enterprise software, fintech, AI and digital health, most of it built out of Portugal.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your portfolio reads like my CV in reverse: Amplemarket sells to revenue teams like the ones I've built for, Feedzai fights the fraud I fought at Pi Network, and Coverflex and CASAFARI run the B2B motions I work on.
summary: Armilar backs technical founders early and helps them become global software companies. The gap I fill is the one that opens right after the first technical wins: product discovery with real customers, a roadmap tied to metrics, and a sales and CS engine that can scale. I've done both for nine years, from AI-powered KYC at 14M-user scale to revenue operations at a New York ad platform, and nearly all of your current companies sell B2B software, mostly out of Portugal.

reasons.title: Fraud and identity at scale
reasons.body: I owned KYC at Pi Network, from about 1M to 14M+ users, including bot detection and silent bans. Feedzai and brighter AI work on the same family of problems.

reasons.title: I've been Amplemarket's customer
reasons.body: I build pipeline stages, SLAs, health scores and dashboards for sales and CS teams. That's the buyer of Amplemarket, and the internal need at Coverflex, CASAFARI and knok.

reasons.title: Technical enough for deep tech
reasons.body: I've written specs for SDKs (HEROW), trained and evaluated ML models, and studied full-stack development. I can translate between your engineers and their customers.

vc_notes.thesis: Enterprise software, fintech and AI overlap strongly with my track record.
vc_notes.stage: Early stage: the point where a first senior PM or RevOps lead matters most.
vc_notes.platform: Experienced partners; no dedicated talent or platform role found on the website.
